p: to shine: That is, gets him favour and prosperity.
the boldness of his face shall: While before he was proud and arrogant, he will become humble and meek.
commandment: That is, that you obey the king and keep the oath that you have made for the same cause.
Be not hasty to go out: Do not withdraw from yourself lightly from the obedience of your prince.
time and judgment: That is, when time is to obey, and how far he should obey.
misery of man is great upon: Man by himself is miserable, and therefore should do nothing to increase the same, but to work all things by wisdom and counsel.
over the spirit to retain the: Man has no power to save his own life and therefore must not rashly cast himself into danger.
hurt: As comes often to tyrants and wicked rulers.
gone from the: That is, others as wicked as they.
place of the holy: They who feared God and worshipped him as he had appointed.
executed speedily: Where justice is delayed, there sin reigns.
work of the wicked: Who are punished as though they were wicked, as in Ec 7:17
